The user has answered all clarifying questions. These decisions are FINAL — draft directly, do not leave [NEEDS CLARIFICATION] markers for these points, and do not ask questions:

- `GET /notes` hides archived notes; `GET /notes?archived=true` returns only archived notes.
- `GET /notes/:id` still returns an archived note.
